meta.scannerDescription: Scan QR codes using your camera or by uploading an image. Free online QR code scanner.
meta.batchDescription: Generate multiple QR codes at once. Upload a CSV file or enter data manually to create bulk QR codes.
meta.templatesDescription: Browse and use pre-made QR code templates. Choose from various styles including classic, modern, gradient, and more.
meta.privacyDescription: Everything runs inside your browser. No QR data, logos, or scan content ever leaves your device.

privacy.badgeLong: Os seus dados nunca saem do seu dispositivo
privacy.intro: Unlike most QR generators, this tool processes everything inside your browser. Your URLs, WiFi passwords, contacts, and scanned codes never touch a server.
privacy.pillar1Body: QR generation runs 100% client-side. Open DevTools → Network tab and confirm: zero outbound requests when you generate a code.
privacy.pillar2Title: No Accounts, No Cookies for Tracking
privacy.pillar2Body: Only a local theme preference and your history are stored — in your browser's localStorage. Clear your browser data and everything is gone.
privacy.pillar3Body: No Google Analytics, no Facebook Pixel, no fingerprinting scripts. The page you see is the page you get.
privacy.pillar4Body: The source code is public. Read it, audit it, host it yourself — no trust required.
privacy.techIntro: We ship an automated test that fails CI if any outbound network request occurs during QR generation. The privacy claim is enforced, not just stated.
privacy.scopeItem1: Your last 50 generated QR codes (history) — in localStorage
privacy.scopeItem3: Your language preference — in a cookie (so server-rendered pages match your locale)
privacy.scopeOutro: That's it. Nothing else. No telemetry. No identifiers.
privacy.trustBody: If you generate QR codes containing extremely sensitive data (medical records, government credentials, internal corporate URLs), self-host this app on your own infrastructure. The Docker image takes 60 seconds to deploy.
